translations.b0472: Part 15  Achieving the Centenary Goal of the People’s Liberation Army on Schedule and Advancing National Defense and Military Modernization with High Quality
translations.b0473: Implement Xi Jinping Thought on Strengthening the Military, implement the military strategic guideline for a new era, uphold the Party’s absolute leadership over the people’s armed forces, implement the system whereby the Chairman of the Central Military Commission assumes overall responsibility, follow the new “three-step” strategy for national defense and military modernization, strengthen the military politically and through reform, science and technology, talent and the rule of law, carry out struggle, war preparation and military development in parallel, accelerate the integrated development of mechanization, informatization and intelligentization, and enhance the strategic capacity to safeguard national sovereignty, security and development interests.
translations.b0474: Chapter 55  Focusing on Improving the Quality and Efficiency of National Defense and Military Modernization
translations.b0475: Accelerate the modernization of military theory, military organizational forms, military personnel, weaponry and equipment, and military governance, improve the capacity of the people’s armed forces to win, and effectively fulfill the missions and tasks of the people’s armed forces in the new era.
translations.b0476: Section 1  Accelerating the Development of Advanced Combat Capabilities
translations.b0477: Strengthen strategic deterrence forces and safeguard global strategic balance and stability. Advance the development of new-domain and new-quality combat forces on a larger scale, in a combat-oriented and systematic manner; accelerate the development of unmanned and intelligent combat forces and counter-capabilities; and strengthen the upgrading and transformation of traditional combat forces. Coordinate the development and application of network information systems, strengthen the development and utilization of data resources, and build an intelligent military system. Accelerate the development of modern logistics. Implement major national defense development projects, step up national defense science and technology innovation and the conversion of advanced technologies, and accelerate the development of advanced weaponry and equipment. Optimize military human resource policies and systems, improve the level of running and educating personnel in military academies, and build a high-caliber, professional, new-type military talent contingent. Implement the project to advance the modernization of military theory. Deepen strategic and operational planning, advance realistic combat-oriented military training, strengthen the integration of combat capability systems, innovate the models for building and employing combat capabilities, and enhance the relevance, initiative and shaping power of military struggle.
translations.b0478: Section 2  Advancing the Modernization of Military Governance
translations.b0479: Improve the leadership and management systems and mechanisms of the people’s armed forces and adjust and optimize the joint operations system. Strengthen and improve strategic management, deepen the coordination of warfighting, military development and war preparation, strengthen the guiding role of operational requirements, innovate management methods and means, and improve the operational efficiency of the military system and the efficiency of national defense resource utilization. Strengthen consultation and assessment for major decisions and supervision of major projects, advance reform of military budget management, improve the military procurement system, improve the statistical evaluation system for military development, fully implement the principle of building the military through diligence and thrift, and follow a path of high efficiency, low cost and sustainable development. Continue to deepen political training and rectification, carry forward fine traditions, and strengthen the rectification and governance of key industries and fields. Further advance the development of the military rule of law, strengthen the supply of laws and regulations and supervision over their implementation, and improve the military rule-of-law system with Chinese characteristics.
translations.b0480: Chapter 56  Consolidating and Enhancing an Integrated National Strategic System and Capabilities
translations.b0481: Strengthen the coordination of military and civilian strategic planning, the alignment of policies and systems, and the sharing of resources and factors, and promote the synchronized improvement of national defense strength and economic strength. Deepen reform across the military and civilian sectors and foster a well-regulated and orderly pattern of military-civilian work in which each party performs its own functions and cooperates closely. Accelerate the building of strategic capabilities in emerging fields, improve the green channel that enables civilian entities to apply cutting-edge scientific and technological achievements in military development, and promote the efficient integration and two-way interaction between new quality productive forces and new quality combat power. Build an advanced national defense science, technology and industry system, optimize the layout of national defense science, technology and industry, improve the equipment procurement management system, and advance the universalization of military and civilian standards. Strengthen the submission of military requirements for national defense development and military-civilian coordination, ensure that major infrastructure fully incorporates national defense requirements, strengthen national defense strategic pre-positioning, and improve the protection of important targets. Uphold military-civilian integration and the integration of peacetime and wartime, accelerate the building of national defense mobilization capacity, strengthen reserve force development, coordinate the national defense mobilization and emergency management systems, and deepen the joint development and sharing of forces and personnel, important facilities and general-purpose equipment. Strengthen the development of modern border, coastal and air defense, and advance the joint efforts of Party, government, military, police and the people to strengthen border and coastal defense. Strengthen honor incentives and the protection of the rights and interests of service members and their families. Deepen national defense education for all and consolidate unity between the military and the government and between the military and the people.
